rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things relating to breathing or the respiratory organs.

example.english: This medicine is quite effective for respiratory diseases.
example.jyutping: tung4 fu1 kap1 jau5 gwaan1 ge3

rows.note: Use this in compounds such as 呼吸道疾病 when the respiratory reference is specifically to the airways.

example.english: A lot of children have respiratory illnesses lately.
